examples.title: Example-1
examples.yaml:
apic:
  access_policies:
    interface_policies:
      cdp_policies:
        - name: CDP-ENABLED
          admin_state: true
examples.explanation: this example configures a CDP policy named `CDP-ENABLED`, which enables CDP on the associated interfaces due to the admin_state property being set to `true`. Since CDP is a Cisco-proprietary protocol, it should be enabled on interfaces connecting to devices only. LLDP is the vendor-agnostic alternative. A CDP policy may also be required for VMM integration as part of the vSwitch policy configuration.
